[Highlight start] It is generally best to **avoid drinking alcohol while taking prednisone** [Highlight end] . While there is no direct chemical interaction listed between them, combining alcohol and prednisone increases overlapping side effects and can worsen the condition you are treating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF11C73J04pwSz5IBpdDcNRJQsWGB4n2VdRvq-zgZI3crmmvTa9dormxSWITPs0t87YbOJ2Sj7cZP6JLu7mYPE6gKmojc-ImdQNXcHuW4vePSTylh-d7KvUZWc1vfMJRc-Zzd12C4N0B00ArRV0VMtzJFdEZGC3rS_xfRIM3HP4CqkEg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQTqfgHhXqQ5PNHlHVg4f5JF8nW6NMqWO6PwK6eUcKfWAhW6ZseRes0HBInIIemoxlIsIwXkwZyfVUrT82lTlbNDEtni1_5BhQjUhk0-wvToNRG6zpydHZlyVgX9VDTciRJKkgDvPqPFcTbM)

### Key Risks of Mixing Prednisone and Alcohol

- **Stomach irritation and ulcers:** Both can irritate the stomach lining. Combining them raises the risk of gastritis, ulcers, and gastrointestinal bleeding—especially if you also take NSAIDs (like ibuprofen) or blood thinners.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXjgu57xCNAnxqdbPxlRLYF99pN6sN6J0mxuk1_ZjIlC5fVHkwcjFtCrdMkaOmiAfFJsYi45hGLlz4jWThcQBNQIcOuD-J6wFSBKRgtLCiVJp4dbNhX7a6wbr4jim3E5V2MZ0-Vesc3qFURCmLXUj1Pa4TbM4FQXg6uw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXFvKUrtCs6EwE4udflL0x9nPRloMLYpgs505lMgQ8deKqzerbJlbNTQ_mzyLuOYI6UJazJX-UzptH2sEvcXftIS1KDN35fZhl9zNCGtylR9uD861-H9pCwHyXzbtbB8d4VehBY1DO8_q_4g)
- **Weakened immune system:** Both prednisone and alcohol suppress immune defenses, making infections harder to fight or recover from.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQTqfgHhXqQ5PNHlHVg4f5JF8nW6NMqWO6PwK6eUcKfWAhW6ZseRes0HBInIIemoxlIsIwXkwZyfVUrT82lTlbNDEtni1_5BhQjUhk0-wvToNRG6zpydHZlyVgX9VDTciRJKkgDvPqPFcTbM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXjgu57xCNAnxqdbPxlRLYF99pN6sN6J0mxuk1_ZjIlC5fVHkwcjFtCrdMkaOmiAfFJsYi45hGLlz4jWThcQBNQIcOuD-J6wFSBKRgtLCiVJp4dbNhX7a6wbr4jim3E5V2MZ0-Vesc3qFURCmLXUj1Pa4TbM4FQXg6uw)
- **Blood sugar swings:** Prednisone can raise blood sugar, while alcohol can cause unpredictable fluctuations.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXFvKUrtCs6EwE4udflL0x9nPRloMLYpgs505lMgQ8deKqzerbJlbNTQ_mzyLuOYI6UJazJX-UzptH2sEvcXftIS1KDN35fZhl9zNCGtylR9uD861-H9pCwHyXzbtbB8d4VehBY1DO8_q_4g)
- **Mood and sleep changes:** Both can contribute to mood swings, anxiety, irritability, and disrupted sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF1-itZCZRW7JDhTX16tC0jyfasUkoaslO8ITElYNqTEwCOCYsAwmNdl2sMjOhKfCEP7gVOSsQvRLxJhsmD9dsbjoasmnGnnW9GGWb_gtvnrB-iAD9UFfztZiT1nPK37JsjqY32DN6_XWK_ScrwvU7EEhehXNqQBdwvAZVlQtUFD4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXFvKUrtCs6EwE4udflL0x9nPRloMLYpgs505lMgQ8deKqzerbJlbNTQ_mzyLuOYI6UJazJX-UzptH2sEvcXftIS1KDN35fZhl9zNCGtylR9uD861-H9pCwHyXzbtbB8d4VehBY1DO8_q_4g)
- **Long-term strain:** Higher doses or longer courses increase risks such as bone thinning (osteoporosis), high blood pressure, and liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF18fJ_-8HDAtyhbxnpU7_c3O_NlAq5ayvDFTODjAI1bdw97b1hWk7LSnxEyM0ZhOa7ByqNSsEV1v3LYKywEnPZuadsxbjh4sGIHnMvJDIHmxNoZLysROipth7q0wLfbFQOvfxqNh7uJOlIquGJkJMY9vBTo9hfBn0C-u6yaQDTtg1I5-BioPX5nsEnJStn5fGtm1Ki8aXOi0aDfc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF11C73J04pwSz5IBpdDcNRJQsWGB4n2VdRvq-zgZI3crmmvTa9dormxSWITPs0t87YbOJ2Sj7cZP6JLu7mYPE6gKmojc-ImdQNXcHuW4vePSTylh-d7KvUZWc1vfMJRc-Zzd12C4N0B00ArRV0VMtzJFdEZGC3rS_xfRIM3HP4CqkEg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXFvKUrtCs6EwE4udflL0x9nPRloMLYpgs505lMgQ8deKqzerbJlbNTQ_mzyLuOYI6UJazJX-UzptH2sEvcXftIS1KDN35fZhl9zNCGtylR9uD861-H9pCwHyXzbtbB8d4VehBY1DO8_q_4g)

### What to Do Instead

- **Check with your doctor or pharmacist:** Ask whether an occasional drink is safe for your specific dose, treatment length, and health history. See [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF11C73J04pwSz5IBpdDcNRJQsWGB4n2VdRvq-zgZI3crmmvTa9dormxSWITPs0t87YbOJ2Sj7cZP6JLu7mYPE6gKmojc-ImdQNXcHuW4vePSTylh-d7KvUZWc1vfMJRc-Zzd12C4N0B00ArRV0VMtzJFdEZGC3rS_xfRIM3HP4CqkEg) for a detailed medical review of overlapping side effects, or [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQTqfgHhXqQ5PNHlHVg4f5JF8nW6NMqWO6PwK6eUcKfWAhW6ZseRes0HBInIIemoxlIsIwXkwZyfVUrT82lTlbNDEtni1_5BhQjUhk0-wvToNRG6zpydHZlyVgX9VDTciRJKkgDvPqPFcTbM) for guidance on timing and waiting after treatment.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF11C73J04pwSz5IBpdDcNRJQsWGB4n2VdRvq-zgZI3crmmvTa9dormxSWITPs0t87YbOJ2Sj7cZP6JLu7mYPE6gKmojc-ImdQNXcHuW4vePSTylh-d7KvUZWc1vfMJRc-Zzd12C4N0B00ArRV0VMtzJFdEZGC3rS_xfRIM3HP4CqkEg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQTqfgHhXqQ5PNHlHVg4f5JF8nW6NMqWO6PwK6eUcKfWAhW6ZseRes0HBInIIemoxlIsIwXkwZyfVUrT82lTlbNDEtni1_5BhQjUhk0-wvToNRG6zpydHZlyVgX9VDTciRJKkgDvPqPFcTbM)
- **Protect your stomach:** Take prednisone with food as directed, and get urgent medical care if you notice signs of stomach bleeding (such as severe stomach pain, black/tarry stools, or vomiting blood/coffee-ground material).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX-ahV58jC6X9Bd2oHc_KswPOikP3It7GDAUR1ySscL4mxfXON8jUJYHt3o75-4mNCpn6Ao-YKlSf1HFnc1As-DSVAM3hB1Vg_TmlmcblwLX1nNxAvOyD82pFR8yi2ws2-GF28feY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXjgu57xCNAnxqdbPxlRLYF99pN6sN6J0mxuk1_ZjIlC5fVHkwcjFtCrdMkaOmiAfFJsYi45hGLlz4jWThcQBNQIcOuD-J6wFSBKRgtLCiVJp4dbNhX7a6wbr4jim3E5V2MZ0-Vesc3qFURCmLXUj1Pa4TbM4FQXg6uw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXFvKUrtCs6EwE4udflL0x9nPRloMLYpgs505lMgQ8deKqzerbJlbNTQ_mzyLuOYI6UJazJX-UzptH2sEvcXftIS1KDN35fZhl9zNCGtylR9uD861-H9pCwHyXzbtbB8d4VehBY1DO8_q_4g)
